title: De l’auscultation médiate, ou, Traité du diagnostic des maladies des poumons et du cœur
version: First French edition, tome I, Paris, J.-A. Brosson and J.-S. Chaudé. Thomas Fisher Rare Book Library, University of Toronto copy digitized by Internet Archive.
lineage: Primary treatise by the clinician and instrument developer, including a retrospective account of the first trial and dated case histories.

passages.locator: Introduction, §§7–13, printed pp. 6–11; plate I (PDF pages 56–61 and 515)
passages.note: Discusses limits of direct ear-to-chest examination, recounts the 1816 paper-roll trial and describes the wooden instrument and interchangeable end configuration.
Patient arrived at Hôpital Necker on 19 December 1817 and underwent cylinder examination the next day. Repeated examination and autopsy followed.

file.representation: Selected reading notes and short excerpts
